assignment.title: MaintainIQ (Batch-20)
assignment.description:
MaintainIQ


Hackathon Overview 


MaintainIQ is a professional maintenance-management platform that gives every physical asset a digital identity, a QR-accessible public page, an issue-reporting workflow, and a permanent service history. The product is designed for schools, universities, hospitals, offices, factories, housing societies, labs, hotels, restaurants, warehouses, and facility-management companies.

The hackathon is not about generating QR codes. The QR code is only the entry point. The actual product value lies in issue triage, assignment, maintenance workflow, evidence, history, accountability, and preventive recommendations.

assignment.title: Helplytics AI – Community Support Platform
assignment.description:
SMIT GRAND CODING NIGHT - April 2026

Helplytics AI – Community Support Platform


 

1. Problem Statement

 

In today’s learning ecosystem:



• Students struggle to find timely help

• Skilled individuals are willing to help but lack a platform

• No structured system exists for:

• Asking for help

• Offering help

• Tracking contributions


Result:

 

• Slower learning

• Missed opportunities

• Weak community collaboration


1. Vision

Build a multi-page, AI-powered community platform that connects people who need help with those who can provide it.

 


2. Product Scope

 Required:

• Multi-page structure

• Clear navigation

• Product-level thinking

• Smart UI/UX

 


1. Core Features

 

• Create help requests

• View and filter requests

• Mark requests as completed

• Multi-page navigation

• Basic user identity

 


2. AI Requirements (Mandatory)

Projects must include at least ONE AI-like feature: Examples:

• Keyword-based categorization

• Smart tag suggestions

• Urgency detection

• Response suggestions

 


3. Design Expectations

3 Expected:

• Card-based UI

• Dashboard-style layouts

• Clean spacing and hierarchy

• Modern UI inspiration:

• Notion

• Stripe

• Linear

 


4. Stack Expectations (Confirm from your trainer as well)

  HTML/CSS (Only for Batch 18)

• Multi-page UI prototype


P JavaScript + LocalStorage (Only for Batch 18)


• Functional frontend with persistence


l HTML/CSS + JavaScript + Firebase / Supabase (Only for Batch 17)


• Functional frontend with firebase/supabase


a HTML/CSS + JavaScript + Node + Express + MongoDB (Only for Batch 16, 17)


• Frontend on html, css, javascript + Backend APIs


t React + Firebase/Supabase (Only for Batch 16, 17)


• Dynamic UI + real-time features


f MERN Stack (Only for Batch 16)

• Full platform architecture

 


5. Bonus Twist

 

Implement any TWO:



• Trust score system

• Leaderboard

• AI suggestion feature

• Notification system

 


6. Final Note

 

This is not an assignment.


This is a product-building challenge. Build something that:

• Feels real

• Looks premium


• Solves a real problem

 


"Writing code is not enough. Building a product is what truly matters."m Structure (Mandatory Pages)

 Landing Page

• Hero section

• Platform overview

• Call-to-action

• Community stats (dummy allowed)


 Authentication Page


• Login / Signup

• Role selection:

• Need Help

• Can Help

• Both


 Onboarding Page

• Name

• Skills

• Interests

• Location


AI Suggestion:

 

• Suggest skills user can help with

• Suggest areas where user may need help


 Dashboard

• Stats cards

• Recent requests

• AI insights

• Quick actions


 Explore / Feed Page

• List of all help requests

• Filters:

• Category

• Urgency

• Skills

• Location


 Create Request Page

• Title

• Description


• Tags

• Category

• Urgency


AI Features:

 

• Auto categorization

• Suggested tags

• Rewrite suggestions


 Request Detail Page

• Full request description

• AI summary

• Helper list

• Actions:

• “I can help”

• “Mark as solved”


 Interaction / Messaging Page

• Basic communication between users


 Leaderboard Page

• Top helpers

• Rankings

• Badges


 AI Center Page

• AI insights

• Suggestions

• Trends


 Notifications Page

• New requests

• Help updates

• Status changes


 Profile Page


• User info

• Skills

• Contributions

• Trust score

• Badges

 Admin Panel (Bonus)

• Manage requests

• Moderate content

• View analytics
